mapper.select: SELECT s.no, s.name_ja AS nameJa, s.name_kana AS nameKana, s.name_ko AS nameKo, s.sake_type AS sakeType, s.rice, s.rice_ko AS riceKo, s.polishing_ratio AS polishingRatio, s.yeast, s.yeast_ko AS yeastKo, s.sake_meter_value AS sakeMeterValue, s.acidity, s.alcohol_percentage AS alcoholPercentage, s.image_url AS imageUrl, ba.name_ja AS brandNameJa, ba.name_kana AS brandNameKana, ba.name_ko AS brandNameKo, br.name_ja AS breweryNameJa, br.name_kana AS breweryNameKana, br.name_ko AS breweryNameKo, br.corporation_name AS corporationName, br.founded_year AS foundedYear, br.ceo, br.prefecture, br.address, br.post, br.phone, br.fax, br.email, br.website, CASE WHEN br.tour_available='Y' THEN TRUE WHEN br.tour_available='N' THEN FALSE ELSE NULL END AS tourAvailable, br.latitude, br.longitude FROM SAKE s LEFT JOIN BRAND ba ON s.brand_no=ba.no JOIN BREWERY br ON s.brewery_no=br.no WHERE s.no=#{no}

SELECT no, name_ko AS nameKo, name_ja AS nameJa, name_kana AS nameKana, image_url AS imageUrl FROM SAKE WHERE name_ko LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search},'%') OR name_ja LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search},'%') OR name_kana LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search},'%') ORDER BY CASE WHEN name_ko=#{search} OR name_ja=#{search} OR name_kana=#{search} THEN 1 WHEN name_ko LIKE CONCAT(#{search},'%') OR name_ja LIKE CONCAT(#{search},'%') OR name_kana LIKE CONCAT(#{search},'%') THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, image_url IS NOT NULL DESC, no DESC LIMIT 10
